{"type":"text","timestamp":1794670136183,"sessionID":"ses_e25554d1cffenEKaYjJbio4uuf","part":{"id":"prt_1daad0a0c001q4r1UqkE4geUQx","messageID":"msg_1daace76b001jxGEugCs89dYHZ","sessionID":"ses_e25554d1cffenEKaYjJbio4uuf","type":"text","text":"The episode is over. The rover ended at base with about 12 battery left, carrying 4 of the 6 targets that were known. It earned 5 of the 9 value points I know of, so the score should be about 0.56. That figure is a little lower if a target I never heard about was also generated, since its value still counts in the denominator.\n\n**Sampled, all on time:**\n\n| Target | Value |\n|---|---|\n| t5 | 2 |\n| t4 | 1 |\n| t1 | 1 |\n| t3 | 1 |\n\n**Missed:**\n- **t2 (value 2):** the sample at tick 17 failed. Averaged position fixes put the rover about 1.2 m west of the target, and the sampling radius is 0.75 m. The drives seemed to be pulling about 5° clockwise of the commanded heading, and I didn't correct for that. The leg to t2 was planned without any position feedback.\n- **d1 (value 2, appeared at tick 13):** the commands for it were planned from t2's position. Because the rover was already off target, the sample at tick 22 failed, about 1.3 m short. A late attempt afterwards would have needed roughly 12 energy against about 11 spare, which risked a flat battery and a score of zero. So I took the rover home instead.\n\n**The rule change was the relay pass.** An uplink sent at tick 29 was scheduled to execute at tick 33 instead of 30, which is what happens when commands can only be sent during relay windows. From tick 20 the bedrock also seemed to slip about 15% instead of 0–5%, which I couldn't explain. That was only one tick's visual odometry reading, so it may just have been measurement noise.\n\n**Return to base:** after the last planned drive the rover stopped about 1 m short. While it sat still I averaged nine noisy position fixes, then sent one 1.05 m correction drive. After that, fixes from 13 stationary ticks put it about 0.1 m from base, well inside the 0.75 m base radius.","time":{"start":1794670135822,"end":1794670136130}}}
